text: Okay, like I literally just told you. I don't have my email address. And my order number? I don't have that either. It's just... this laptop I got. I want to return it. Why do I need all this other stuff? Can't you just help me return it? I'm Emma Smith, and my zip code is 10192. Is that enough?
zh: 好的，就像我刚才告诉你的。我不记得我的电子邮件地址。还有我的订单号？我也没。就是……我收到的这台笔记本电脑。我想退回它。为什么我需要所有这些其他的东西？你不能直接帮我退回吗？我是艾玛·史密斯，我的邮编是10192。这足够了吗？
